admission.justification: Whole-binding validation prevents partial inherited data granting a role or task authority no launch supplied.

applicability: Reading launch identity at bound MCP startup or tool calls.
conditions: AR_PASEO_AGENT_ID is present for this bound path.
exclusions: No agent ID retains ordinary unbound-server behavior.
statement: read_agent_binding returns nothing for a process without an agent id and otherwise requires a complete launch binding: minted UUID identities, one of the seven native roles, an absolute report path, readable canonical references and exactly the reference pattern admitted for that role. The one earlier system-specialist spelling reads as Investigator; its taskless, sprint or sprint/master references must still agree with the recorded selection.
